purpose: Compile a target-faithful, relational perfume architecture and the smallest discriminating experiment without claiming that composition predicts perception or beauty.
target_first_sequence: Lock the target identity, reference scope, recognizers, invariants, and forbidden drift before consulting inventory.
Declare the perceptual functions whose omission would damage that target.
Select exactly one primary architectural strategy because it explains the target relations, not because it is fashionable, ingredient-rich, or globally preferred.
Add zero to two secondary strategies only when each owns a distinct target function that the primary does not own.
Place every target function exactly once in a temporal, spatial, and textural layer and define every intended inter-layer transition.
Separate the target or ideal formula reference from the current-inventory build reference before any material projection.
Project material hypotheses through the current V5 workbook, user overlay, and ExactStockRef layers without turning ownership into execution authority.
Choose zero or one nonredundant omission, addition, ratio, or evidence-only n-ary experiment through Architectural Delta.
Collect blinded exact-scope sensory and preference evidence before any sensory or hedonic conclusion.
Keep safety, stability, similarity, compounding, purchase, release, and physical-success claims outside this compiler.
separated_constructs: TARGET_FIDELITY: whether the sample preserves the locked recognizers, invariants, exclusions, and identity boundaries of the target.
PERCEPTUAL_DEPTH: experienced foreground-background, near-far, surface-interior, shadow-radiance, or other relational dimensionality under a declared protocol.
RICHNESS: differentiated, coherent perceptual information that remains available without collapsing into muddiness or undifferentiated intensity.
CONFIGURATIONAL_INTEGRATION: whether components or facets form an emergent perceptual object rather than a list of separately identifiable notes.
HIERARCHY_AND_CONTRAST: the salience ordering and mutually revealing relations among perceptual functions.
TEMPORAL_DIFFERENTIATION: observed changes, persistence, returns, reversals, and transitions across declared timepoints.
INTENSITY: perceived magnitude at a declared timepoint and endpoint; intensity is not depth, richness, or liking.
FAMILIARITY: assessor recognition or prior-exposure response; familiarity is not target fidelity or liking.
DETECTABILITY: evidence that a difference or feature is perceived under the declared comparison; detectability is not preference.
LIKING: criterion-specific evaluative response under a blinded protocol; liking is not inferred from target fidelity, depth, or chemical composition.
PREFERENCE: directional choice or tie between scoped alternatives for one declared criterion.
WANTING_TO_RESMELL: desire for renewed exposure, measured separately from liking and fascination.
WEAR_ACCEPTANCE: willingness to wear in a declared context, measured separately from immediate strip liking.
COMFORT: reported ease, softness, or affective safety, kept separate from liking and familiarity.
FASCINATION: sustained attentional pull or curiosity, kept separate from comfort and liking.
TENSION: experienced unresolved contrast or pressure, which may be intentional or aversive and is not automatically a defect.
RELIEF: experienced release or resolution after tension, measured as a temporal response rather than inferred from formula structure.
FATIGUE: reported perceptual or evaluative weariness under a qualified exposure schedule.
AVERSION: negative evaluative response or avoidance, retained as its own endpoint rather than folded into low liking.
PERSISTENCE: continued perception of a declared endpoint across time; volatility or modeled substantivity is not observed persistence.

complexity_firewall.rule: Complexity means target-linked perceptual depth, differentiated richness, relations, transitions, and potential hedonic consequences. A sparse formula may be deeply complex when each material creates an exact relation; a large formula may be perceptually flat, redundant, muddy, or incoherent.
forbidden_proxies: supplier prestige, novelty, rarity, price, or naturalness
number of predicted interactions without isolated evidence
length or eloquence of a model explanation
complexity_firewall.required_evidence: A complexity claim requires observations bound to protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, timepoint, endpoint, presentation sequence, and schedule hash. Design descriptions remain hypotheses until those observations exist.

prohibited_inferences: Do not convert formula composition, molecular descriptors, supplier copy, price, novelty, or prestige into liking or beauty.
Do not convert predicted OAV, vapor pressure, boiling point, logP, substantivity, or modeled volatility into perceived behavior.
Do not treat a predicted interaction, co-occurrence, or pairwise relation as evidence of perceptual synergy.
Do not infer n-ary layered synergy from pairwise evidence; require isolated arms and the n-ary interaction contract.
Do not map a note, adjective, target recognizer, or desired emotion directly to one molecule without target-linked evidence.
Do not infer similarity, identity match, safety, stability, physical compatibility, or release readiness from computational design.
Do not collapse target fidelity, depth, richness, liking, wear acceptance, comfort, fascination, and wanting-to-resmell into one synthetic beauty score.
Do not average duplicated canonical sensory cells or interpolate missing cells.
Do not treat protocol-level order balancing as proof that the realized observations are balanced.
Do not silently rebase a formula when stock strength, carrier, identity, product basis, or ExactStockRef changes.

architecture_compilation: Exactly one primary strategy is required.
Zero to two secondary strategies are allowed and each must own a target function not owned by another strategy.
Every declared target function must be owned exactly once across strategy assignments.
Every declared target function must be placed exactly once across architecture layers.
Every transition must connect two existing, distinct layers and declare intended effect and failure mode.
The family adapter is applied only after the target and strategy lock and may not alter target identity, recognizers, invariants, forbidden drift, or ideal lineage.
Dior Homme Parfum-style dark-radiant carved depth is one valid chiaroscuro instance, not a universal architecture and not an automatic family default.
A strategy cannot receive a score, rank, or ingredient-count reward.
Any count-as-complexity, predicted-OAV-as-perception, or composition-score-as-hedonic shortcut causes HOLD.
A proposed change must be zero or one target-linked nonredundant intervention with controlled arms; otherwise HOLD or NO_CHANGE.
inventory_and_execution: Reparse every row of the authoritative V5 Current Inventory Master and Aliases and Non-Equivalents sheets at execution time.
Join workbook authority, user-authoritative overlay, and ExactStockRef as separate layers; no layer silently replaces the others.
Owned status without an ExactStockRef is not physical-execution readiness.
Unknown or unspecified concentration basis remains visible and cannot establish active equivalence, OAV equivalence, or molecular-mechanism authority.
The target or ideal architecture may include a computationally available or procurement-pending material while the current build remains blocked.
Zero citrus and zero musk are valid. Citrus and musk are selected only for a target-linked function.
Neroli is support-only unless orange blossom or neroli is explicitly central to the target.
Zero or one precise musk is the default; musk layering requires distinct functions and nonredundancy evidence.
Tonalide, Macrolide, and Musk Ketone remain excluded unless an explicit design exception states why their specific function is necessary.
Inventory projection grants no purchase, formula-rebase, general-substitution, sensory, safety, stability, compounding, or release authority.
hedonic_evidence: Fit target fidelity, depth, richness, configurational integration, liking, wanting-to-resmell, wear acceptance, comfort, fascination, tension, relief, fatigue, aversion, and persistence as separate criteria.
Use real blinded comparisons; exclude ties from directional counts and fake wins while retaining NO_PREFERENCE in the Davidson indifference likelihood.
Bind every item label exactly once to its build, physical sample, provenance manifest, sampling or dose receipt, and batch; reject missing, extra, or swapped item/sample bindings.
Bind substrate, application, environment, maturation, apparatus, carryover controls, and—on skin—wearer and body-odor context.
Require scoped comparison, assessor, protocol, criterion, timepoint, session, matrix, partition, realized presentation order, and sequence metadata.
Diagnose disconnected graphs, sparse evidence, assessor heterogeneity, realized pair-order imbalance, first-position effects, sequence defects, carryover, temporal crossover, and criterion leakage.
Use deterministic group-isolated held-out validation against a declared probabilistic baseline and require a positive grouped-bootstrap lower bound above the practical margin.
Zero held-out bootstrap replicates, one unordered set of sample hashes, and accuracy-only validation cannot promote liking.
V1 and V2 receipts remain readable provenance but require complete V3 item and context binding before exact-scope promotion.
Blotter liking cannot establish skin wear acceptance, and another wearer or body-odor context cannot establish the owner's result.
Composition, molecular descriptors, predicted OAV, supplier descriptions, price, rarity, naturalness, and prestige cannot enter a liking fit or hedonic release axis.
A hedonic model may prioritize the next blinded comparison but cannot approve formula mutation, purchase, compounding, safety, stability, or release.
Any result that is unscoped, order-confounded, disconnected, sparse, baseline-failing, or missing required cells remains WITHHELD or DIAGNOSTIC.

architecture_outputs: locked target identity and lineage hash
one primary and zero to two nonoverlapping secondary strategies
current-inventory material projections and physical-build blockers
zero or one Architectural Delta experiment
explicit authority flags and claim ceiling
